title: Question 31
passage:
The notice says to bring a photo ID, but the customer’s email just says to bring the receipt.
A. Have them print the email on a full sheet of paper. B. I sent that email from our general address. C. I’ll check whether the receipt is enough before we tell them what to bring.
passageZh:
公告說要帶附照片的身分證明文件，但寄給客戶的電郵只說要帶收據。
A. 請客戶把電郵印在一整張紙上。 B. 我用我們的一般聯絡信箱寄了那封電郵。 C. 我先確認只帶收據夠不夠，再告訴客戶該帶什麼。
